digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler integration test — idempotency oracle
propositions: RP-02 S2 T2 relocated absence/tombstone/comment operations (clear_absent, siblings) from binding_store to binding_lifecycle, but the integration idempotency test's clock freeze only patches binding_store._now_iso, so it no longer intercepts timestamp writes from moved operations.
The idempotency oracle's ability to catch regressions that make clear_absent stamp updated_at unconditionally on an unchanged pass was silently weakened by the module relocation.
The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, so the narrowed patch reach does not cause test failure.

Unit-tier coverage of the clear_absent no-stamp contract exists independently in test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, so the integration regression risk is contained but the oracle's reach should be restored.

clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window idempotency pass (both call sites are gated on out-of-window-but-alive keys), so seeding an unconditional-stamp mutation cannot drive the integration test RED as originally premised.
